# OpenCode v2 · CLIProxyAPI provider [English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [![CI](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider) [![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) [![Tested with OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/tested_OpenCode-2.0.26-informational)](docs/verification.md) Use [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI) (CPA) models in OpenCode v2, with model discovery, tool calls, conversation summaries and HTTP/SSE or WebSocket connections. This is an independent plugin, not an official OpenCode or CPA product. It takes inspiration from [CPA's official Pi plugin](https://github.com/router-for-me/pi-cliproxyapi-provider) and uses OpenCode's native Responses runtime and public plugin APIs. ## Features - Connect to CPA with a setup wizard and store the API key in OpenCode's credential store. - Load model capabilities and reasoning options from CPA's model list. - Cache the model list and temporarily retain models that disappear from it. - Toggle Fast mode for models that support it, or pause and resume requests. - View session duration, tokens per second (TPS), and token and cache usage. - Use the same terminal commands with a local or remote OpenCode server. ## Requirements - **OpenCode `>=2.0.26 <3`**. Tested on Windows with **2.0.26**; other versions have not been verified. OpenCode v1 is not supported. - A running CPA service with an API key and support for `/v1/models` and `/v1/responses`. ## Install Install the plugin through OpenCode, specifying the version: ```sh opencode --version opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1 opencode plugin list ``` This keeps the plugin at `0.1.1` until you choose to upgrade. You do not need `npm install -g` or a local copy of this repository. You can also add it to the `plugins` array in your existing `opencode.json(c)`: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": ["opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1"] } ``` The default global config directory is `~/.config/opencode` (`%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode` on Windows). Project configs also apply. Keep your other settings and use only one entry for this plugin. If you previously loaded it from a source directory, remove that old entry. The server plugin and terminal interface (TUI) are included in the same package. **Do not add a second entry to `cli.json`.** If you use a remote OpenCode server, install the plugin there; the terminal loads its TUI automatically. See [OpenCode's plugin documentation](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/plugins). ## Connect to CPA 1. Open OpenCode and run `/cpa-connect`. 2. Enter the CPA address, including any reverse-proxy subpath. 3. Enter the API key. The input is hidden. The plugin checks the connection before saving it to OpenCode's credential store. 4. Select a model in OpenCode. Use `/cpa-status` to check the connection. OpenCode's built-in `/connect` also works, but saves the connection before checking it. `/cpa-connect` checks first, so a failed attempt leaves the previous connection unchanged. Do not commit config files containing API keys to Git. ## Commands | Command | Description | | --- | --- | | `/cpa-connect` | Check and save a CPA address and API key | | `/cpa-status` | Show the connection, model list, Fast mode, selected transport, compaction and pending settings | | `/cpa-refresh` | Refresh the model list and apply any changes | | `/cpa-fast` | Turn Fast mode on or off; the setting is saved between restarts | | `/cpa-pause` | Pause new CPA requests; requests already sent continue normally | | `/cpa-resume` | Resume paused requests | | `/cpa-stats` | Show duration, TPS, and token and cache usage for this session | The footer shows the connection status and statistics for the last turn. Fast mode sends `priority` only for models that advertise support for it. It does not change reasoning effort or guarantee a faster response. `/cpa-status` distinguishes an unreachable OpenCode server (RPC) from failed CPA verification. It shows the selected transport and its fallback notes, not proof that a WebSocket request succeeded, along with the compaction mode and any reload needed to apply saved settings. TPS is measured over the whole turn, including tool calls and retries, rather than just the time spent generating text. See [how statistics are calculated](docs/reference.md#pause-and-statistics). ### Applying a connection or directory change Some saved changes need a reload before new requests use them (`reloadRequired: true`). The TUI reloads the current location automatically when needed. This cancels paused requests and resets session statistics. Clients using RPC must handle the reload themselves; see [applying changes](docs/reference.md#applying-changes). ## Configuration For use without the TUI, set `CLIPROXYAPI_BASE_URL` and `CLIPROXYAPI_API_KEY` in the server environment. Plugin options take precedence over environment variables, which take precedence over the saved connection. A key saved for one address is not used with a different address. See the [configuration reference](docs/reference.md#configuration) for the full rules and options. To change plugin options, edit its existing entry: ```jsonc { "plugins": [{ "package": "opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1", "options": { "transport": "auto", "compaction": "summary", "modelsDev": false } }] } ``` - `transport: "auto"` chooses HTTP or WebSocket based on the model list and available runtime support. - `compaction: "summary"` uses OpenCode's conversation summaries. This is the default. - `modelsDev: false` disables price lookup. The default is `true`, which fetches public prices from `https://models.dev/api.json`. These are estimates, not CPA billing data. Once configured, the plugin reads the CPA model list at startup, or loads it from cache and refreshes it in the background. Later refresh failures can trigger retries. Model requests you make through OpenCode may incur charges from your provider; this plugin does not include a CPA service or account. ## Upgrade or uninstall Publishing a new version does not upgrade an existing pinned installation. Back up your config before upgrading. Run `opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@` with the published version you want, then check `opencode plugin list` for duplicate or old entries. `opencode plugin update` skips entries pinned to an exact version. Restart OpenCode if it has not picked up the change. To uninstall: ```sh opencode plugin remove opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1 ``` Also remove any entry you added manually to a project config. Credentials, sessions and stored plugin data are managed separately by OpenCode; uninstalling the plugin does not guarantee their removal. ## Troubleshooting | Problem | What to check | | --- | --- | | CPA commands are missing | Check the server's plugin list and version. The TUI does not need a separate `cli.json` entry. | | A key is saved, but the connection is offline | Check `/cpa-status`, or run `/cpa-connect` to verify the address and key again. | | CPA was unavailable on first startup | Run `/cpa-refresh` when CPA is back. The first model-list request is not automatically retried if there is no cache. | | Changes are saved but not active, or a request is blocked after disabling Fast | Reload the current location. This cancels paused requests and resets statistics. | | HTTP is used instead of WebSocket | Check `transportNote`. OpenCode may have fallen back to HTTP. | | Native compaction is unavailable | Keep `summary`. Native compaction is optional and has not been tested with real CPA. | | Models are missing from `opencode models` | On 2.0.26, that command uses a separate location. Check the session's model picker, or call `model.list` with the session's location. | For bug reports, include your OpenCode and plugin versions, OS, and steps to reproduce the problem. Remove keys, private addresses and conversation content from any status output or logs you share. See [security reporting](SECURITY.md). ## Test coverage Real CPA tests used OpenCode `2.0.26` and `gpt-6.1-sol` at commit `11eb30e`. The later pause-timing fix (`16afc4b`) was tested offline only. Other models have not been verified with real CPA. Automated tests cover additional protocol and recovery scenarios using a mock CPA service. CI also installs the packaged plugin and checks it with OpenCode `2.0.26` and test credentials. Native compaction has only been tested with a mock; the TUI has module tests but has not had a full manual terminal walkthrough. Details are in the [test coverage table](docs/verification.md). ## Isolated host run Use a separate test environment, not your regular OpenCode config or real CPA credentials. Set `OPENCODE_CLI` to the OpenCode `2.0.26` executable. `OC2CPA_SANDBOX` can override the directory used for test configuration and data. The smoke tests use local mock services. ```sh npm ci --cache .forge/local/npm-cache --no-audit --no-fund bun test bun run typecheck bun run smoke:package ``` [Development](docs/development.md) · [Technical reference](docs/reference.md) · [Release procedure](docs/releasing.md) · [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) · [MIT license](LICENSE)

# OpenCode v2 · CLIProxyAPI provider

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![CI](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider)
[![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![已测试的 OpenCode 版本](https://img.shields.io/badge/tested_OpenCode-2.0.26-informational)](docs/verification.md)

在 OpenCode v2 中使用 [CLIProxyAPI](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI)（CPA）提供的模型，支持模型发现、工具调用、对话摘要，以及 HTTP/SSE 和 WebSocket 连接。

这是一个独立插件，并非 OpenCode 或 CPA 官方产品。功能参考了 [CPA 官方 Pi 插件](https://github.com/router-for-me/pi-cliproxyapi-provider)，通过 OpenCode 原生 Responses 运行时和公开插件接口实现。

## 功能

- 通过连接向导设置 CPA，将 API key 保存到 OpenCode 的凭证存储中。
- 从 CPA 模型列表读取模型能力和可选的推理档位。
- 缓存模型列表，暂时保留从列表中消失的模型。
- 为支持的模型切换 Fast 模式，或暂停、恢复请求。
- 查看会话耗时、每秒输出 token 数（TPS），以及 token 和缓存用量。
- 本地和远程 OpenCode 服务端均可使用这些终端命令。

## 使用要求

- **OpenCode `>=2.0.26 <3`**。已在 Windows 上测试 **2.0.26**，其他版本尚未验证。不支持 OpenCode v1。
- 可用的 CPA 服务和 API key；服务需支持 `/v1/models` 和 `/v1/responses`。

## 安装

使用 OpenCode 的插件命令安装，并指定版本：

```sh
opencode --version
opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1
opencode plugin list
```

这样会固定使用 `0.1.1`，直到你手动升级。无需执行 `npm install -g`，也无需下载本仓库源码。

也可以在现有 `opencode.json(c)` 的 `plugins` 数组中添加：

```jsonc
{
  "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json",
  "plugins": ["opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1"]
}
```

默认全局配置目录为 `~/.config/opencode`，Windows 下为 `%USERPROFILE%\.config\opencode`；项目配置也会生效。请保留其他设置，本插件只添加一次。如果此前从源码目录加载，请移除旧的路径配置。

服务端插件和终端界面（TUI）包含在同一个包中，**不需要再添加到 `cli.json`**。使用远程 OpenCode 服务端时，在服务端安装插件即可，终端会自动加载对应的界面。详见 [OpenCode 插件文档](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/plugins)。

## 连接 CPA

1. 打开 OpenCode，运行 `/cpa-connect`。
2. 输入 CPA 地址；使用反向代理时，请包含完整子路径。
3. 输入 API key，输入内容不会明文显示。插件验证连接成功后，会将其保存到 OpenCode 的凭证存储中。
4. 在 OpenCode 中选择模型，用 `/cpa-status` 查看连接状态。

也可以使用 OpenCode 内置的 `/connect`，但它会先保存连接再验证。`/cpa-connect` 则先验证，连接失败时不会替换原有设置。不要将含有 API key 的配置文件提交到 Git。

## 常用命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| `/cpa-connect` | 验证并保存 CPA 地址和 API key |
| `/cpa-status` | 查看连接、模型列表、Fast、选用的传输方式、压缩模式和待生效设置 |
| `/cpa-refresh` | 刷新模型列表并应用变更 |
| `/cpa-fast` | 开启或关闭 Fast 模式，重启后保留设置 |
| `/cpa-pause` | 暂停发送新的 CPA 请求；已发出的请求继续处理 |
| `/cpa-resume` | 恢复暂停中的请求 |
| `/cpa-stats` | 查看当前会话的耗时、TPS、token 和缓存用量 |

界面底部会显示连接状态和上一轮对话的统计。Fast 模式只会向明确支持该功能的模型发送 `priority` 参数，不改变推理档位，也不保证响应更快。

`/cpa-status` 会区分 OpenCode 服务端 RPC 断连与 CPA 验证失败。传输状态显示选用的方式及回退说明，不代表 WebSocket 请求已经成功；同时显示压缩模式，以及保存的设置是否仍需重新加载才能生效。

TPS 按整轮对话的耗时计算，包含工具调用和重试时间，不等同于模型生成文本时的速度。详见[统计说明](docs/reference.md#pause-and-statistics)。

### 连接或模型列表变更何时生效

部分设置保存后，需要重新加载当前工作目录才能用于后续请求，此时状态中会显示 `reloadRequired: true`。TUI 会在需要时自动重新加载，同时取消暂停中的请求并重置会话统计。通过 RPC 调用的客户端需要自行处理重新加载，详见[设置生效说明](docs/reference.md#applying-changes)。

## 配置

不使用 TUI 时，可以在服务端环境中设置 `CLIPROXYAPI_BASE_URL` 和 `CLIPROXYAPI_API_KEY`。插件配置优先于环境变量，环境变量优先于已保存的连接。为某个地址保存的 key 不会用于其他地址。完整规则和选项见[配置参考](docs/reference.md#configuration)。

修改插件选项时，编辑已有的插件配置项即可：

```jsonc
{
  "plugins": [{
    "package": "opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1",
    "options": {
      "transport": "auto",
      "compaction": "summary",
      "modelsDev": false
    }
  }]
}
```

- `transport: "auto"`：根据模型列表和运行时支持情况选择 HTTP 或 WebSocket。
- `compaction: "summary"`：使用 OpenCode 的对话摘要压缩上下文，这是默认方式。
- `modelsDev: false`：关闭价格查询。默认值为 `true`，会从 `https://models.dev/api.json` 获取公开价格，用于估算费用，不代表 CPA 的实际账单。

配置连接后，插件启动时会读取 CPA 模型列表，或先使用缓存再后台刷新。后续刷新失败时可能自动重试。通过 OpenCode 发起模型请求可能产生上游费用；本插件不提供 CPA 服务或账户。

## 升级与卸载

发布新版本不会升级已有的固定版本安装。升级前先备份配置。执行 `opencode plugin add opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@<版本号>`，指定要安装的已发布版本，再用 `opencode plugin list` 检查是否有重复或旧的配置项。`opencode plugin update` 会跳过已固定版本的插件。如果变更尚未生效，重启 OpenCode。

卸载命令：

```sh
opencode plugin remove opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider@0.1.1
```

如果曾手动添加项目配置，也请移除对应的插件项。凭证、会话和插件数据由 OpenCode 单独管理，卸载插件不保证同时删除这些数据。

## 常见问题

| 问题 | 处理方法 |
| --- | --- |
| 找不到 CPA 命令 | 检查服务端的插件列表和版本，无需在 `cli.json` 中单独配置 TUI。 |
| key 已保存，但连接仍然离线 | 用 `/cpa-status` 查看状态，或运行 `/cpa-connect` 重新验证地址和 key。 |
| 首次启动时 CPA 不可用 | CPA 恢复后运行 `/cpa-refresh`。没有缓存时，首次模型列表请求失败不会自动重试。 |
| 设置已保存但未生效，或关闭 Fast 后请求被拒绝 | 重新加载当前工作目录；这会取消暂停中的请求并重置统计。 |
| 使用了 HTTP 而不是 WebSocket | 查看 `transportNote`，OpenCode 可能已回退到 HTTP。 |
| native 压缩不可用 | 保留默认的 `summary`。native 是可选功能，尚未在真实 CPA 上测试。 |
| `opencode models` 没有列出模型 | 2.0.26 中，该命令使用单独的 location。请在会话中选择模型，或调用 `model.list` 时指定会话所在的 location。 |

反馈问题时，请附上 OpenCode 和插件版本、操作系统及复现步骤。分享状态信息或日志前，请移除 key、私人服务地址和对话内容。安全问题见[报告说明](SECURITY.md)。

## 测试情况

真实 CPA 测试使用 OpenCode `2.0.26` 和 `gpt-6.1-sol`，对应提交 `11eb30e`。后来的暂停计时修正（`16afc4b`）仅做了离线测试。其他模型尚未在真实 CPA 上验证。

自动化测试使用模拟 CPA 服务，覆盖更多协议和故障恢复场景。CI 还会安装打包后的插件，使用 OpenCode `2.0.26` 和测试凭证进行检查。native 压缩目前只通过模拟服务测试；TUI 有模块测试，但尚未在实际终端中完整手动测试。详细范围见[测试覆盖表](docs/verification.md)。

## 隔离开发与测试

请使用单独的测试环境，不要使用平时的 OpenCode 配置或真实 CPA 凭证。将 `OPENCODE_CLI` 设为 OpenCode `2.0.26` 可执行文件的路径；`OC2CPA_SANDBOX` 可指定测试配置和数据的存放目录。冒烟测试只连接本机的模拟服务。

```sh
npm ci --cache .forge/local/npm-cache --no-audit --no-fund
bun test
bun run typecheck
bun run smoke:package
```

# Changelog / 变更记录

## 0.1.1

- Fix rounded session durations carrying into the next minute: `1m60s` now
  displays as `2m00s`. Token, cost and timing accounting are unchanged.
- `/cpa-status` now shows the selected transport, compaction mode, fallback
  notes and pending settings. An OpenCode RPC outage is distinguished from
  failed CPA verification; a selected WebSocket transport is not a success claim.
- Manual tag publishing now verifies the exact public npm artifact and OIDC
  provenance, then creates a bilingual GitHub Release with tarball and checksum
  attachments. Retries continue only for identical artifacts; published versions,
  tags and conflicting assets are never overwritten.

- 修复耗时显示的分钟进位：`1m60s` 正确显示为 `2m00s`，不改变 token、费用或耗时记账。
- `/cpa-status` 补充选用的传输方式、压缩模式、回退说明及待生效设置，区分宿主 RPC 断连与 CPA 验证失败；选用 WebSocket 不代表请求已经成功。
- 手动 tag 发布会核验公开 npm 产物及 OIDC provenance，并生成双语 GitHub Release、包文件和校验和附件。同内容可安全重试，不覆盖已发布版本、正式 tag 或冲突附件。

**Verification remains bounded:** OpenCode `2.0.26` on Windows, packaged-plugin
mock checks and automated regressions; no additional real CPA or paid-model tests.
Existing native-compaction, physical-TUI and dependency-advisory limitations
still apply. See the linked verification and security notes.

测试仍限于 Windows / OpenCode `2.0.26` 的安装产物模拟验证与自动化回归，未新增真实 CPA 或收费模型测试；native 压缩、实际终端手动测试及依赖告警的既有边界保持不变。

## 0.1.0

First public GitHub + npm release / 首个 GitHub + npm 公开版本。

- OpenCode v2 native Responses provider for CPA, with directory discovery,
  connection wizard/native credential storage, HTTP/WS and summary compaction.
- Reasoning variants, capability-gated Fast preference, catalog cache/stale
  retention, pause/resume and per-session statistics.
- Server and TUI exports in one TypeScript source package; fixed-version official
  installation, bilingual READMEs, MIT license and documented upgrade/uninstall.
  The TUI declares its OpenTUI JSX source explicitly so installed TSX does not
  accidentally resolve React outside the development checkout.
- Minimal Windows CI verifies the packed/installed artifact against OpenCode
  `2.0.26` and loopback mocks. Publishing is an explicit manual tag workflow.

首发包含 CPA 模型发现、原生凭证与连接向导、HTTP/WS、summary、Fast、目录缓存、暂停及统计；同包服务端/TUI、固定版本安装、双语文档及最小产物 CI。

**Verification is bounded:** real observations are from `11eb30e`; the
pause-accounting fix at `16afc4b` is offline-only. Native compaction and a physical
TUI walkthrough are not real-CPA acceptance claims. See
[the verification matrix](docs/verification.md).

# Security / 安全

Only the current `0.1.x` release line is maintained. Host compatibility and tested
coverage are narrower than a general security support guarantee; see
[verification](docs/verification.md).

## Reporting

Please do not put exploit details or secrets in public issues. Use GitHub's
[private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/security/advisories/new)
for this repository. If that feature is unavailable, open a public issue asking
for a private reporting channel **without** sensitive details.

Include the plugin/host version, operating system, impact and a minimal redacted
reproduction. Never include API keys, `.npmrc` tokens, native credential-store
files, raw acceptance/host logs, private CPA URLs or conversation content.
If a credential was exposed, revoke/rotate it with its owner; deleting a comment
or making a later clean commit does not revoke it.

## Dependency advisories at 0.1.0–0.1.1

The pinned OpenTUI/Solid dependency chain includes Seroval versions flagged by
[GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c) and
[GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp](https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp)
(untrusted `fromJSON` / `fromCrossJSON` deserialization). npm reports critical
severity transitively; this release does **not** claim a clean dependency audit.
The plugin does not import Seroval, use Solid web SSR, or deserialize network data
through those APIs. This source-level observation is not a security audit of
OpenCode or its complete dependency graph. The tested host/UI versions are retained
rather than forced to untested versions; revisit these advisories with a tested
host upgrade. Patched Seroval releases exist, but are outside the pinned Solid
`~1.5.0` dependency range.

## Package verification

```sh

# With OPENCODE_CLI set to a real 2.0.26 binary:
bun run smoke:package
```

`check:package` creates a real npm tarball under `.forge/local/package`, validates
its file allowlist/metadata/exports, and installs it (not a link) into an isolated
consumer with pinned UI peers. It imports the server and TUI entrypoints from
that installation. `smoke:package` additionally runs the existing host smoke
against the installed package's `src` directory and requires host `2.0.26`.

The server and TUI remain TS/TSX source, as supported by OpenCode v2; no custom
compiler, bundled host runtime, installer or updater is provided. A module import
check does not exercise a physical terminal.

## Isolated host run

All `smoke:*` checks must use a local sandbox and fictional credentials. Do not
run them using your daily home/config, an existing real CPA connection or a
production key. The scripts start/stop **only their isolated service**.

PowerShell example (use your actual host binary path):

$env:OPENCODE_CLI = 'C:\path\to\opencode.exe'
$env:OC2CPA_SANDBOX = Join-Path (Get-Location) '.forge/local/smoke'

# Configuration and behavior reference

[English quick start](../README.md) · [中文快速上手](../README.zh-CN.md)

## Configuration

A connection is **one address plus one API key**. Priority is plugin `options`,
environment, then the stored native connection. The snapshot reports the source
of both halves (`addressSource`, `keySource`).

| Source | Address | Key |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Plugin options | `baseURL` | `apiKey` (supported, but do not commit secrets) |
| Server environment | `CLIPROXYAPI_BASE_URL` | `CLIPROXYAPI_API_KEY` |
| Native credential store | Saved address | Saved key |

An explicit address takes only a matching key. Another explicit source may
supply it if that source has no address or the same address; a stored key may
complete the pair only if its saved address matches. Otherwise the partial
configuration is refused. An explicit key without an address keeps the stored
address or defaults to `http://127.0.0.1:8317`. A changed explicit pair is saved
through OpenCode's native key method; an unchanged pair is not rewritten.

The native `/connect` form saves first, then reports verification. The plugin's
`/cpa-connect` wizard verifies before saving; failure leaves the old pair intact.
Connection state and RPC registrations are location-scoped. The TUI never reads
server credential files or contacts CPA; it uses server RPC, including remotely.

| Option | Default / purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `providerID`, `integrationID` | `cliproxyapi`; identifiers for registration and credentials |
| `providerName` | Display name, `CLIProxyAPI` |
| `transport` | `auto`; alternatively `http` or `websocket` |
| `compaction` | `summary`; alternatively opt-in `native` |
| `package` | HTTP runtime override; normally `@opencode/ai/providers/openai-compatible/responses` |
| `websocketPackage` | WS runtime override; normally `@opencode/ai/providers/openai/responses` |
| `catalogTimeoutMs` | Directory request timeout; 10000 ms |
| `catalogStaleTtlMs` | Stale retention; seven days from the first miss |
| `modelsDev` | `true`; `false` disables public price lookup |
| `modelsDevURL` | `https://models.dev/api.json`; optional price catalog override |
| `modelsDevTimeoutMs` | 5000 ms |

Reverse-proxy subpaths are preserved:

```text
https://gateway.example.com/cpa -> https://gateway.example.com/cpa/v1
http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1        -> http://127.0.0.1:8317/v1
```

The plugin reads `<baseURL>/models?client_version=<plugin/version>`; the runtime
appends `/responses`. Use TLS for non-loopback deployments. An explicit catalog
URL is a network destination; never put a credential in a URL or a public report.

## Applying changes

OpenCode compiles an existing provider binding at location boot/reload. Publishing
a new directory does not hot-update the compiled runtime. Snapshots distinguish:

- `applied`: the runtime uses the described directory/settings;
- `reloadRequired`: newer saved settings await location reload;
- `fastEffectiveModels`: count that currently receives priority, not a pending wish.

`connect`, `refresh` and `setFast` return the snapshot. The TUI reloads only when
needed and re-reads status; a headless caller uses the same public API:

```ts
const result = await client.rpc.call({ rpcID: "cliproxyapi", method: "refresh", input: {} })
if (result.output.snapshot.reloadRequired) await client.location.reload()
const status = await client.rpc.call({ rpcID: "cliproxyapi", method: "status", input: {} })
```

Supply the correct location for location-scoped calls. Before reload, a new
request that would send a Fast tier withdrawn by the saved directory/preference
is refused, rather than sending obsolete priority. In-flight requests are left
alone. The check uses an in-memory shared registry, not persisted cache.

A location booted without a usable binding (no key or failed first directory
read) has nothing to replace: its first successful connect/refresh can apply
immediately. This is the tested host's empty-boot behavior, not plugin hot reload.
See [ADR 0002](adr/0002-apply-boundary.md).

## Directory and models

| CPA directory field | OpenCode mapping |
| --- | --- |
| `slug` / `id` | Real CPA model ID |
| `display_name` / `name` | Display name |
| `context_window` / `max_context_window` | Context limit; fallback 128000 |
| `max_tokens` / `max_output_tokens` / `max_completion_tokens` | Output limit; fallback 16384, clamped to context |
| `input_modalities` | Input capabilities; text always included |
| `supported_reasoning_levels` | Variants with semantic `reasoningEffort` |
| `service_tiers` | Nonempty declaration enables Fast capability |
| `additional_speed_tiers` | Not a Fast capability signal |
| `visibility: "hide"` | Model registered but disabled |

A plain OpenAI `{ data: [...] }` list is accepted with the documented fallbacks.
Malformed/error responses are failures, never empty catalogs. A legal empty
catalog is a success. Missing capability information is not invented.

The cache is per connection in OpenCode plugin storage. Its one-way fingerprint
includes address/key identity, but the key itself is not written into the cache.
A matching cache registers immediately, then refreshes in the background. A
failed read preserves the last good directory. A successful read retains newly
missing models as stale until their window expires; reappearing models become
current. Selecting a stale model warns, without promising upstream availability.

Generation/request guards reject superseded connection reads. Directory commits
are serialized in issue order; no compensating re-save/re-publish is used. Cache
write failures cannot change served request parameters.

After a **later** failed background/manual read, or a read retaining stale models,
recovery starts at 60 seconds, grows by 1.5x, and caps at 300 seconds. A fresh
directory clears it; manual refresh, connection switch and unload cancel it.
The very **first uncached boot read is not retried**: refresh manually once CPA
recovers. Each attempt is a bounded directory read, not a model call.

## Transport and compaction

| `transport` | Selection |
| --- | --- |
| `auto` | WS if a visible entry declares `prefer_websockets` and the selected WS runtime is known to carry a channel; otherwise HTTP/SSE |
| `http` | Always HTTP/SSE |
| `websocket` | Request WS; an incapable runtime is diagnosed in `transportNote`, and the host may fall back |

The compatible Responses package is HTTP-only; the native OpenAI Responses
package carries WS. The plugin registers no HTTP request/response hooks, so it
does not disable the host's socket path. On 2.0.26 the OpenAI route supplies its
own `gpt-5*` defaults (medium reasoning, automatic reasoning summary); the HTTP
compatible route does not.

OpenCode normally reuses one socket per session, sending incremental turns with
`previous_response_id`. After summary, the plugin changes the public WS handshake
generation header `x-oc2cpa-socket`: the host opens a new socket, avoiding appending
compacted history to CPA's pre-summary connection state. This does not mean
creating a new OpenCode user session. See [ADR 0001](adr/0001-native-runtime.md).

`compaction: "native"` is optional and **not real-CPA verified**. It is declared
only for a runtime with a compaction endpoint; otherwise summary is retained and
`compactionNote` explains why. The mock native checkpoint path also resets the
socket generation. Do not infer real support from that mock.

The host/mock matrix observed socket reuse, invalid-response-ID retry, upgrade
refusal fallback, separate parallel-session sockets, rotated credentials and
socket cleanup. Already-emitted output is not replayed on retry. These are
[tested boundaries](verification.md), not a promise for every CPA deployment.

## Reasoning, Fast and prices

Reasoning variants map to `reasoningEffort` → wire `reasoning.effort`. Fast maps
to `serviceTier: priority` → `service_tier`, only when `service_tiers` declares
capability. It does not change reasoning effort. Priority applies to every
request for that model, including primary, title, summary and generate requests.

Fast is provider-scoped, persistent and off by default. A failed preference
write leaves the previous preference and applied state intact. Applying an
existing binding requires reload as described above.

Price matching uses the CPA reference plugin's alias rules, namespace stripping,
normalized fallback and provider preference over the public models.dev catalog.
Ambiguous disagreeing prices with no preferred provider remain unknown. A failed
lookup never prevents model registration.

- Standard price is the default.
- Fast price (`experimental.modes.fast.cost`) is used only when the model also
  receives priority; absent Fast price means the standard price, not an invented multiplier.
- Context tiers (`tiers` or legacy `context_over_200k`) map to host cost entries.
- Unmatched models have no invented price. These are estimates, **not a CPA bill**.

## Pause and statistics

Pause holds the next request, without a timer. A request already in flight
finishes. Resume is an RPC call independent of model calls. Session interruption
cancels its wait without sending a request. Pause is per location/provider and
not persisted; other providers are unaffected.

Location shutdown explicitly cancels held waits and subscriptions: waiting for
ordinary cleanup would deadlock a hook still waiting at the pause gate. Reload
starts an unpaused generation with empty statistics; it does not release old
waits as requests. A service restart also clears these in-memory statistics.

| Metric | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| Turn | One host execution from `session.execution.started` to success/failure/interruption; tool continuations are part of it |
| Effective duration | Turn wall time minus that session's actual pause-gate waiting |
| TPS | Output tokens / effective seconds for the **whole turn**, including tool/retry time; not decode speed |
| Tokens | Step usage keyed by assistant message ID; missing usage is not invented |
| Total | Host `input + output + reasoning + cache.read + cache.write` |
| Retries | Counted from scheduled retries; a reused message ID is not double-counted |
| Sessions | Each session, including a child, is independent; no folding into parent stats |

Title and compaction calls are outside the agent-loop turn and not counted.
TUI disconnect does not reset server statistics; reconnect reads a fresh snapshot.

## Connection RPC

RPC ID: `cliproxyapi`. Calls and events are location-scoped; external clients must
filter location when subscribing. Events are live-only, so re-read on reconnect.

| Method | Input | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `status` | `{}` | Connection snapshot |
| `verify` | `{ address, key }` | Probe only; requires both, never borrows the active key |
| `connect` | `{ address, key }` | Verify, save native connection, bind; includes apply state |
| `refresh` | `{}` | Read directory bypassing cache; includes apply state |
| `setFast` | `{ enabled }` | Persist preference; includes apply state |
| `pause`, `resume`, `pauseState` | `{}` | Pause state |
| `stats` | `{ sessionID }` | Known session statistics, if any |
| `sessions` | `{}` | Observed sessions, most recent first |

Events: `changed`, `stale`, `pause.changed`, `stats.changed`. Stats events occur at
turn boundaries, not every step. Snapshots include catalog age/count/stale IDs,
cache state, verification and source fields, applied/pending Fast counts,
price count and transport/compaction diagnostics. Keys are never included, only
`(redacted, N chars)`; snapshots can still contain a private address, model IDs or
session context, so redact before sharing.

# Releasing / 发布流程

Maintainer procedure for `Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider` → npm
`opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider`. Users install an exact published version through
OpenCode; they do not need these steps.

## Before a tag

1. Update package version, lock metadata and `src/host.ts`'s `PLUGIN_VERSION`
   together; the package check asserts agreement. Keep the pinned host API
   dependencies unless deliberately testing a compatibility change.
2. Update **both** READMEs, changelog and support boundaries. Do not relabel mock
   coverage as real CPA acceptance. No screenshot is required; any future terminal
   screenshot must redact keys, private addresses, paths and conversation data.
3. Run locked install, typecheck, `bun test`, `bun run smoke:package` with the
   fixed real host and loopback mocks. Inspect the tarball's file list and exports.
4. Scan the **Git history being pushed**, the current tree and the npm artifact
   for secrets. Ignore rules do not remove already-committed history. Check private
   endpoints, personal filesystem paths, raw logs, `.env`/`.npmrc`, auth files,
   temporary sandboxes and dependencies as well as conventional token patterns.
   If a real secret is found, stop publication and rotate it through its owner;
   do not silently rewrite shared history or merely hide it in a later commit.
5. Check dependency advisories and license obligations. No `npm audit fix --force`
   or untested dependency upgrade just to obtain a green count.
6. Push reviewed main, observe actual GitHub CI, then create `v<package.version>`
   pointing to that commit. Never push all local development refs/worktrees.

## Publication gate

`.github/workflows/ci.yml` runs on pull requests/main pushes and has read-only
repository permission. It never publishes.

`.github/workflows/publish.yml` has **only `workflow_dispatch`**. Select an existing
exact version tag (not main), for example:

```sh
gh workflow run publish.yml --ref v0.1.1
```

The workflow checks that the tag matches the manifest, repeats the same Windows
verification, downloads the exact checked tarball, and publishes it using npm
OIDC with required provenance. Only the publish job receives `id-token: write`;
no stored npm publish token is used. A separate Release job receives
`contents: write` and no OIDC permission. The tarball is not rebuilt between
verification and publication.

Before publishing, the workflow reads the exact public npm version. Only a 404
means it may publish; a registry/auth/network failure stops it. An existing version
must have the same integrity and tarball bytes, with OIDC provenance, or the run
stops without overwriting anything. After a publish, bounded registry reads
reconcile even a lost CLI response without repeating the write.

The Release job rechecks public npm bytes, requires the existing tag to resolve
to the verified commit, and uses the version's bilingual changelog plus links to
both READMEs and verification/security boundaries. It creates a draft, attaches
the checked `.tgz` and `SHA256SUMS`, then publishes the Release. On retry, matching
notes/assets are preserved and missing assets are added; conflicting content
stops the run. Tags and existing assets are never moved or replaced.

If npm succeeded but a later step failed, rerun the original failed jobs or
manually dispatch **the same tag**. Full dispatch repeats CI and must reproduce
the same artifact. Do not bump a version just to finish its Release, and do not
switch to token publishing after OIDC failure.

### npm trusted publishing

A package owner configures npm's **Trusted Publisher** in the package settings:

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Provider | GitHub Actions |
| Organization/user | `Mistakey` |
| Repository | `opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider` |
| Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |
| Environment | Leave empty (this workflow does not declare an environment) |

Use npm's direct-publish permission if the UI offers staged/direct choices.
The job uses npm >=11.5.1 and Node >=22.14; trusted publishing from a public repo
creates provenance automatically. Follow npm's current expiry/verification rules.
Do not disable 2FA or commit a token to work around an authentication failure.

**First-package bootstrap:** trusted publishing is configured in an existing
package's settings. If npm cannot configure the never-published name, the owner
must first publish the **verified tarball** through official npm browser login/2FA:

```sh
npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
npm publish .forge/local/package/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider-0.1.0.tgz --access public --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

A maintainer can perform the publish after the owner logs in, but browser/OTP
approval stays with the owner. Never ask them to paste a token or OTP into an
issue/chat. Record whether the first release used this manual bootstrap or OIDC;
a local bootstrap must **not** claim CI provenance. Configure OIDC for subsequent
versions instead of storing a long-lived CI token. Do not publish a dummy version
or republish an existing immutable version to test authentication.

## After publication

- Read npm's `dist.integrity`, download the public exact version and compare it
  with the verified tarball. Exercise that installed artifact with mock fixtures.
- Confirm the workflow's GitHub Release is public on the same tag, with both
  language links, the verified tarball and checksum attachments.
- Publication does **not** authorize updating an existing installation. Install
  into the user's **confirmed** OpenCode/config location only after a
  backup, with `opencode plugin add <name>@<exact-version>`. Check the resolved
  version and entries, preserving unrelated settings and credentials.
- Do not send a paid model request as an installation check. Loading a configured
  connection may itself perform directory GET/background refresh and models.dev
  reads; disclose that before touching the daily environment.
- If a bad immutable release escapes, publish a corrected version and document
  rollback/pinning; do not move its Git tag or pretend an artifact was replaced.

中文摘要：检查双语文档、许可、依赖、Git 历史及实际 npm 产物；PR/普通 push 不发布。精确 tag 手动触发 OIDC 发布，随后自动核验公开 registry 的 integrity、包字节及 provenance，并生成双语 Release 与 tgz/校验和附件。npm 已成功时可重试同一 tag：同内容继续收尾，冲突则停止，不覆盖版本、移动 tag 或替换附件。OIDC 与 Release 写权限分属不同作业，认证失败不退回 token。0.1.0 首发的人工引导不代表 CI provenance。发布不授权升级日常安装；安装固定新版本须另获用户同意，不追加收费模型测试。

# Verification scope / 验证范围

A passing CI badge describes that workflow, not universal compatibility.
CI 通过只说明该工作流通过，不代表所有模型、宿主版本或真实部署均兼容。

## Fixed baselines

- **Real CPA:** OpenCode `2.0.26` on Windows, plugin `0.1.0` at
  [`11eb30e`](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/commit/11eb30e),
  only `gpt-6.1-sol` (low reasoning for the final combinations). CPA server version
  was not established. Real price lookup was disabled.
- **Offline delta:**
  [`16afc4b`](https://github.com/Mistakey/opencode2-cliproxyapi-provider/commit/16afc4b)
  corrects pause-accounting event order using clock replay and a fictional-key
  host check. It was **not** re-tested as a full real-CPA build.
- **Release checks:** typecheck, Bun unit/native-runtime tests, package contents
  and both exports, then one installed-package run on OpenCode `2.0.26`, Windows,
  loopback mocks and fictional keys. No real CPA model requests are part of CI.

`0.1.1` adds duration-display and status-detail regressions plus publication
retry/conflict tests. These are offline changes, not new real-CPA acceptance.
Release changes do not expand those historical acceptance boundaries.
Historical failed/blocked checks remain historical; targeted fixes do not
retroactively turn them into a full-build review or all-model acceptance.

## Matrix

| Area | Offline / isolated-host evidence | Real CPA observation and limit |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Connection | Native form, masked wizard, verify-before-save, saved/verified/apply states, credential isolation | Directory authentication, saved native connection and reload state observed |
| Models | Directory mapping, hidden entries, limits, modalities and reasoning variants | One model ID and one synthetic image; not all models |
| Fast | Capability gating, HTTP/WS serialization, persistence/write failure, reference prices | WS priority + low observed; final off save/reload observed, **no subsequent off model request**; real prices disabled |
| Catalog | Matching cache, refresh ordering, stale retention, bounded recovery | Directory reads only; no real outage/stale matrix |
| Requests | Native HTTP/SSE and WS, tools, continuation and recovery | HTTP/WS tool content, incremental same-socket turns, one image and reconnect observed |
| Compaction | Summary continuation and mock native checkpoint | HTTP summary, WS follow-up on a new socket with old raw/tool context removed; **native not tried** |
| Pause | Cancellation, provider scope, reload/unload cleanup | WS wait/resume and cancellation without a model frame |
| UI / stats | RPC/TUI module, location/session isolation, usage accounting | RPC/reconnect and TUI module rendering, **not a physical terminal walkthrough**; pause overlap corrected offline at `16afc4b` |

A prior real-WS test failure was traced to missing authentication in its temporary
test proxy, not a production WS defect. Other earlier intermittent test failures
whose causes were not established are not relabeled as proven environment issues.
Raw acceptance logs are intentionally **not public**: they can contain credentials,
private endpoints or conversation data. Public support claims are stated here
without depending on a private tracker or local evidence path.

## Important limits / 重要边界

- Tested host: `2.0.26` only. The accepted load range `>=2.0.26 <3` is not a test matrix;
  v1 and unsupported major versions are refused.
- Native compaction is opt-in, best effort and not real-CPA verified. Default summary stays required.
- The initial failed **uncached** directory read needs manual refresh; later background/manual failures or stale directories schedule recovery.
- Host fallback from WS to HTTP is not evidence of a successful WS exchange.
- TUI module checks do not stand in for physical terminal acceptance or screenshots.
- TPS covers the whole turn; prices are estimates, not billing or decode speed.

# 使用 OpenCode 原生 Responses 运行时，而非按参考插件复刻通信栈

> Source: oc2cpa-bya (D2, D7, D8), design snapshot retained at commit `8bc28d0a766bf610e1424f3a0d4580f7adc88146`

CPA 官方 Pi 插件通过运行时补丁改造 Pi 的 Codex 实现；本项目仍以其功能为基准，但选择 OpenCode v2 原生 Responses 运行时加公开 hooks，不复制补丁或自建完整通信栈，也不先按模型家族拆成多种协议。这样可复用宿主的序列化、工具/推理回放及连接管理，代价是受宿主接口和版本变化约束，必须用实际请求与流事件验证差异，不能仅凭“OpenAI 兼容”判断成功。

研究快照中 CPA 的 `/v1/responses` 与 `/backend-api/codex/responses` 使用相同 handler；v2 发布包具备 Responses 的 WS 通道、续传及 HTTP 回退入口，支持这条路线，但不等于整个链路已经验证。HTTP hooks 可能影响 WS 选择；summary 后的上下文正确性是发布门槛。公开接口无法满足必保行为时报告限制并请求改议，不能隐式修改核心或悄悄删除功能。

默认保留宿主 summary，不移植 Pi 的上下文溢出触发机制；summary 重建上下文后通过公开 WS handshake hook 改 socket generation，让宿主新建连接，避免 CPA 续用旧服务端上下文。native 只作显式 opt-in 的尽力能力，不为它修改核心或阻塞交付；真实支持范围以 [README](../../README.md#accepted-verification-scope) 为准，不能把 mock checkpoint 通过当成真实支持。

依据：[CPA 路由快照](https://github.com/router-for-me/CLIProxyAPI/blob/f1d4a94ef4398349716f2db5bbc3a27624c174a7/internal/api/server_routes.go)、[OpenCode provider 文档](https://opencode.ai/v2/docs/providers)、[@opencode/ai 2.0.26 发布包](https://registry.npmjs.org/@opencode/ai/-/ai-2.0.26.tgz)。

# 保存与运行时生效分开，使用宿主公开的 location reload

> Source: oc2cpa-bya (D6, D11), oc2cpa-bya.13 (Q4 B), oc2cpa-bya.16 (Q5 A); design snapshot retained at commit `8bc28d0a766bf610e1424f3a0d4580f7adc88146`

OpenCode 2.0.26 在 location boot/reload 编译已有 provider binding；重新发布目录不等于运行时已按新参数分发。采用机器可读的 `applied` / `reloadRequired` 两阶段契约，而不另建热更新或脚本框架：TUI 自动调用公开 `location.reload()` 后重读快照，无界面调用方读同一标志自行 reload；相同 binding 不要求 reload。空 boot registry 的首次成功接入可立即生效，这是隔离宿主验证过的例外，不是插件热更新能力。

等待 apply 时，已编译 binding 若会发送当前已保存目录/偏好撤回的 priority，则拒绝该模型的新请求，已在飞请求不动。该检查只读按 provider 与连接 fingerprint 索引的进程内共享目录规则，因为同一 provider 的 global/location 插件实例可能不同；不从持久缓存逐请求仲裁。目录提交按发出顺序串行收敛，不保留补偿性重存或重发机制；缓存只作启动优化，不能因缓存写入失败改变实际参数。这保留真实参数和凭证隔离要求，同时避免恢复机制叠加成状态框架。

代价是已有 binding 的改变需要 reload；reload 清除内存统计并取消暂停中的请求，而不是偷偷放行。调用方须区分已保存偏好与 `fastEffectiveModels` 描述的实际效果。公开用法及首次接入边界见 [README](../../README.md#applying-a-connection-or-directory-change)。
